In today’s warehouses, the only constant is change. New products, shifting demand, and unpredictable returns put strain on traditional automation systems. SightWorks™ was built to thrive in this environment — eliminating SKU onboarding, adapting to evolving processes, and getting smarter with every pick.
No onboarding required
Most automation needs massive SKU training. SightWorks™ uses AI that generalizes across packaging so your system handles new items confidently, without barcodes or manual programming.
Built around your process
SightWorks™ improves with real-world feedback. It refines strategies for higher performance, less intervention, and compounding ROI.
Product detection and selection

SightWorks™ begins by generating a confidence map of the scene using RGB and 3D data. Unlike systems that rely on traditional item segmentation or SKU databases, our AI models identify high-confidence grasp points directly — no SKU onboarding required. This generalized approach enables fast deployment and instant adaptability to new or changing inventory.
Precision pick and place
AutoModel™ enables the system to learn new products on the fly, eliminating the need for SKU pre-training or reprogramming.
Designed to integrate into goods-to-robot workflows, the solution scales across stations, applications, and inventory profiles as operations evolve.
Advanced grasp planning and tool selection enable reliable picking and precise placement across a wide range of product types and materials.
AutoModel™ continuously learns from real operations, allowing the system to adapt to new SKUs and changing conditions without downtime or manual programming.

OSARO’s bagging solution, built for fast-paced e-commerce, 3PL, and retail fulfillment, uses SightWorks to handle diverse products and AutoModel to learn new SKUs on the fly — delivering smarter, faster automation that keeps pace with changing inventory.
No more waiting for the robot to find items. Our advanced object detection quickly processes SKUs of all shapes, sizes, and materials.
No more shipping the wrong items. Accurately scan and identify each item for precise order fulfillment and record-keeping.
SightWorks™ identifies each item in real time, no barcodes or SKU onboarding required.
The robot grips and positions products directly into an open bag, adapting to different shapes, sizes, and packaging materials.
OSARO’s kitting system supports variable kit structures, product pairings, and packing sequences.
Each item is identified, verified, and placed with precision so every kit is complete, correct, and ready to ship.
SightWorks™ perception software recognizes each product in the mix with instant adaptability to any product mix.
Each kit is checked for accuracy before release, with continuous feedback loops improving precision and reducing errors.
Using 3D vision, predictive motion planning, and real-time decision-making, it accurately picks and places cases of all shapes and sizes.
Smart motion planning and predictive grasping ensure every pick is stable and controlled, even with shrink wrap, voids, or misaligned boxes.
SightWorks perception software scans each pallet and builds a 3D map with instant adaptability to any product mix.
Each box is placed according to your workflow, while reinforcement learning improves speed and handling with every pallet.
